fields.title: Hands-on Echocardiography in Heart Failure 2027
fields.purpose: A two-day accredited symposium on guideline-directed therapy, device therapy and care transitions in heart failure for cardiologists, internists, advanced practice providers and nurses in New England.
fields.provider.name: Beacon CME
fields.faculty.selection: Faculty are selected by the Beacon CME planning committee with NECS programme chairs
fields.learningObjectives: 1. Apply current guideline-directed medical therapy sequencing in HFrEF. 2. Identify patients who may benefit from device therapy. 3. Plan safe transitions of care after hospitalisation for heart failure.
fields.needsAssessment: NECS 2026 member survey (n=412) and regional readmission data show gaps in therapy titration after discharge and in referral for device evaluation.
fields.outcomes.methods: Pre/post knowledge test; 90-day practice survey (Moore level 5)
